facts.fact: Both failures happen before AccountCache construction, so neither failure demonstrates the product read/preserve/save branch being executed on a real symlink.
Installed Debian package provenance says libwine and wine64 version 10.0~repack-6; installed Windows CPython nuspec and package source say 3.12.10.
Exact Debian 10.0~repack-6 source CreateSymbolicLinkW emits a FIXME stub message then returns TRUE, without creating any path or reparse point.

Readonly disassembly of the actual installed kernelbase.dll exported CreateSymbolicLinkW shows both return paths assign eax=1. The code only handles debug strings and logging. It has no path creation call; this independently matches the exact Debian source stub.
CPython 3.12.10 os.symlink calls CreateSymbolicLinkW and raises only when its BOOLEAN result is false; TRUE leads to Py_RETURN_NONE with no link verification.
The actual installed pathlib.symlink_to delegates to os.symlink; is_symlink checks lstat mode and returns False for ignored missing-path errors; readlink delegates to os.readlink.

CPython test.support.os_helper.can_symlink cannot be copied unchanged for this stub: it treats a non-raising os.symlink call as capability success and then removes the path, which this stub did not create.

The product protects FileNotFoundError cases when lstat succeeds or raises other OSError, and treats lstat FileNotFoundError as genuine absence. For the stub no symlink path exists at all; no product rule can infer a link from an absent path.

Microsoft documents a nonzero success result and zero failure result for CreateSymbolicLinkW. Developer Mode is required for the unprivileged-create flag; the existing test OSError skip retains those legitimate native Windows privilege failures.

The installed ntdll exports wine_get_version. Presence of this Wine-specific export is a narrower actual runtime identity predicate than sys.platform==win32, platform.system==Windows, or WINEPREFIX alone. This agent did not load or call the export.

diagnosis.source_proven_cause: The installed Wine success-only CreateSymbolicLinkW stub defeats the tests preexisting prerequisite check (skip only on creation exception). The fixture setup fails before exercising AccountCache.
